decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical process data block layout.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
BIOS, DOS and COMMAND sources include pdb.inc; DOS MISC and MSPROC and COMMAND INIT use its fields.
The prior 1741-byte MSPROC comparison found two address-byte differences and one separately tracked minor-version byte (review 092).
The prior MISC comparison found five marked address bytes and one separately tracked version byte differing among 682 bytes (review 079).
limitations: Selected comparisons support the field offsets exercised in those modules, not every structure field or configuration. Version, final addresses and complete core binary identity remain unverified.
